title: From Flow-Box Invariants to Global Conservation Laws: Machine Learning-Assisted Detection of Singularities and Near-Integrability
abstract: arXiv:2610.23760v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conservation laws reveal invariant structure in dynamical systems and constrain their evolution to lower-dimensional level sets. Locally, however, per the flow-box theorem, every $d$-dimensional system generically admits $d-1$ functionally independent conservation laws near a regular point even though, generically, only a few such laws persist globally. Data-driven methods typically learn conservation laws on a prescribed region of phase space from which training samples are drawn, leaving their behavior beyond that region unresolved. We formulate this local-to-global continuation problem and develop an {expanding-domain neural deflation} framework that tracks the number of independent conservation laws over nested domains. The method recovers the expected $d-1$ local invariants and detects their successive breakdown as the domain expands, relaxing to the expected global conservation law limit. translated_title: 从流盒不变量到全局守恒律：机器学习辅助的奇点与近可积性检测
translated_abstract: 守恒律揭示了动力系统中的不变结构，并将系统的演化约束在低维水平集上。然而在局部范围内，根据流盒定理，每个d维系统在正则点附近通常都存在d-1个函数独立的守恒律，尽管通常只有少数这样的守恒律能够全局保持。数据驱动方法通常仅在训练样本所抽取的相空间指定区域内学习守恒律，使其在该区域之外的行为悬而未决。我们提出了这一局部到全局的延拓问题，并开发了一个“扩张域神经去缩”框架，在嵌套域上追踪独立守恒律的数量。该方法恢复了预期的d-1个局部不变量，并随着域的扩张检测到它们的相继失效，最终收敛到预期的全局守恒律极限。它区分了局部不变量（……摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“扩张域神经去缩”框架，通过在嵌套扩张的相空间域上追踪独立守恒律的数量，实现了从流盒定理的局部不变量到全局守恒律的自动检测，并能识别奇点与近可积性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an expanding-domain neural deflation framework that tracks the number of independent conservation laws over nested domains, enabling machine learning-assisted detection of the transition from local flow-box invariants to global conservation laws, as well as singularities and near-integrability.
